volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

contrast.tooltip: Same S-curve as Scan Grid. 1 = unity. Below 1 compresses highs so bins don’t clip as fast. 0 = mid grey. Negative inverts the curve.

brightness.tooltip: Same gain as Scan Grid, after contrast. 1 = unity. 0 = black. Default 0.2 stays dim. Negative is the same gain, then invert.

minFreq.tooltip: Lowest frequency at the bottom of the face. Zoom with Max Freq to spend vertical pixels on a band.

maxFreq.tooltip: Highest frequency at the top of the face (must stay above Min Freq).

historySeconds.tooltip: Seconds of audio across the face width. Longer = slower waterfall scroll.

volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

pulseMode.tooltip: Forward: one-way schedule (Time). Forward-Reverse: that schedule then its time-mirror, peak once. Reverse: only the return trip. Count is the one-way pulse count.

antialiasing.tooltip: Off: first sample at or after each time. Fixed: seed-locked 0/+1 on stacked pulses. Dither: the same 0/+1, re-rolled every Trigger / Loop. Robin1: ±1 around the true time. Robin2: ±2 (second ±1 around the first pick). End Delay uses the same land.

wave.tooltip: Trigger: single-sample pulses. Gate: 50% high between pulses. Saw/Ramp: naive ramp from one pulse to the next. Tri/Sine: one cycle starting and ending at 0. Each grain starts at a pulse and ends at the next.

seed.tooltip: Locks the antialiasing pattern. Same Seed = same offsets on every trigger. Change Seed for a different noise texture.

count.tooltip: Pulses in the train (one-way). Slider 1–128; type above the slider for denser trains (DSP up to 16384).

endTime.tooltip: Duration of the pulse schedule (E_k span). Wired ƒ sets the Loop period to 1/ƒ; Time stays this window inside that period (pulses at t ≥ 1/ƒ are dropped).

endDelay.tooltip: Seconds after the last pulse. Positive: silence after. Negative: end early and drop the tail. One shot: End fires at last pulse + this (not before 0). Loop: cycle is Time (Forward-Reverse: 2×Time) plus this. Wired ƒ: wrap stays 1/ƒ; this still cuts or pads the train inside the period.

bpm.tooltip: This metronome's tempo (beats per minute). When BPM In is wired, that value is the tempo and this slider is ignored. Unwired uses this slider. Independent of other metronomes.

pulseWidth.tooltip: Gate high duty of each cycle (0..1). 0.5 = square. Affects Gate 0-1.

beats.tooltip: Beats per bar for the click. Beat 1 = hi click (downbeat); other beats = lo click.

timeNumerator.tooltip: Numerator of Numer/Denom × whole note. Numer=0 → no clock. 1/4 = one beat at BPM.

timeDenominator.tooltip: Denominator of Numer/Denom × whole note. At Numer=1: Denom 4=¼, 8=⅛, 16=1/16, 32=1/32.

timingMode.tooltip: Normal = Numer/Denom as written. Dotted = 1.5×. Triplet = 2/3×.

mode.tooltip: Sync = follows the master playhead, so metronomes with the same BPM and Reset share beats. Free = runs its own phase from its last Reset. In both, a BPM change only changes speed from that moment (no phase jump).

amplitude.tooltip: Output level for gate and trigger outs.

tuning.tooltip: A4 reference Hz. MIDI 69 maps to this frequency when converting Pitch→Hz.

octave.tooltip: Add octaves to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

semitones.tooltip: Add semitones to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

cents.tooltip: Add cents / 100 to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

multiply.tooltip: Hz-domain multiply after Pitch→Hz. Applies to ƒ and inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

add.tooltip: Hz-domain offset after Multiply. Applies to ƒ and inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

aa.tooltip: Antialiasing. Off is the raw clip. ADAA1 uses the previous sample. ADAA2 uses two previous samples and falls back when the input is flat.

drive.tooltip: Input push into the soft-knee curve.

threshold.tooltip: Amplitude (0...1) where limiting starts. Below this the driven signal is unchanged.

knee.tooltip: How gradual the transition from Threshold toward full scale is. 0 = hard at Threshold.

mode.tooltip: Pattern: up, dn, up/dn, dn/up, or random over Arp Keys.

rate.tooltip: Free-run step rate when Trigger and f are unconnected. Ignored whenever f is patched (external rate in Hz). Trigger edges always win over both.

steps.tooltip: Steps before pattern restart (esp. Random). 0 = natural wrap / free-run RNG.

seed.tooltip: RNG seed for Random. Reset re-seeds from this value.

octaveOffset.tooltip: Transpose arpeggiated pitch by whole octaves (−4…+4). Applied to ♯/♭, ƒ, and inc outs.

sequenceOffset.tooltip: Rotate the pattern (including Random) by this many steps. Same seed, different offset → a shifted sequence.

highFreq.tooltip: Sweep start frequency (the click). Latched on each Trigger. Clamped to 50 Hz ... half the sample rate.

lowFreq.tooltip: Frequency the sweep settles toward (a tuned body). 0 = keeps falling. Latched on each Trigger.

sweepTime.tooltip: Time to fall from High Freq to Low Freq + 50 Hz. Latched on each Trigger. From Robin Schmidt's SweepKicker, RS-MET.

chirp.tooltip: Tail power of the sweep. + holds the highs longer, then drops fast. - drops fast at first, then lingers low. Acts at once. From Robin Schmidt's SweepKicker, RS-MET.

chirpShape.tooltip: Attack knee vs decay at the same tail power. + keeps the start frequency a little longer, - rounds the knee. Acts at once. From Robin Schmidt's SweepKicker, RS-MET.

wave.tooltip: Waveform family. Sine. TriSaw = triangle that morphs to saws with Wave Shape. SinFatSaw = sine-shaped TriSaw (bulging fat saws). From Robin Schmidt's SweepKicker, RS-MET.

waveShape.tooltip: Saw-down (-1) ... symmetric (0) ... saw-up (+1). No effect on Sine. From Robin Schmidt's SweepKicker, RS-MET.

phase.tooltip: Start phase offset. Trigger hard-resets the oscillator to this phase. 0 = clean start at zero. +-0.25 = starts at a peak: hard click.

decay.tooltip: Amplitude envelope: seconds to fall 60 dB (T60) after a hit. Drives the 0–1 output and the Kick level. Acts at once.

amplitude.tooltip: Kick output level. Does not scale the 0–1 output.

voices.tooltip: How many stolen tails can fade at once. Only one kick is live; a retrigger fades the previous over Fade Time. Decay does not stretch Fade Time.

voiceFade.tooltip: On: a stolen voice fades out over Fade Time instead of cutting (no retrigger click, including Voices 1). Off: hard cut.

inputGain.tooltip: Drive into the limiter before detect/GR. Raise to hit Threshold harder (more pump).

threshold.tooltip: Level where gain reduction starts. Lower = more compression/pump on typical program.

ratio.tooltip: How hard GR climbs above Threshold. ~4–8 = firm. ~12–20 = heavy pump.

lookaheadEnabled.tooltip: How early the detector hears the hit. The audio is delayed by this much, and Attack uses that head start. Off = gain moves on the sample itself.

lookaheadMs.tooltip: Look-ahead delay in ms when Look-ahead is On. Part of the sound (not host-compensated).

lookaheadSamples.tooltip: Extra look-ahead in samples (added to LA Time). Hidden by default.

attack.tooltip: How long gain takes to finish falling after a hit is seen. If this is shorter than Look-ahead, the fall finishes before the hit plays and the output stays at Threshold. If this is longer, the hit can still poke through.

hold.tooltip: How long gain reduction is held after it stops deepening, before Release starts. A new peak restarts the hold. 0 = release right away.

release.tooltip: How fast gain recovers after a hit — the main pump/breathe timing. Longer = slower swell back.

amplitude.tooltip: Final output trim after GR. 0…1. Lower if the bus is too hot; no autogain.
